node Identity "Identity"
node Topic "Swarm topic"
node Space "Space"
node Agent "Agent"
group objects "Durable Objects" {
  node Router "RouterObject"
  node Swarm "SwarmObject"
  node Automerge "Automerge replicator"
  node Feeds "FeedReplicator"
  node State "SpaceStateMachine"
  node Indexer "Indexer"
  node Process "Agent process"
}
edge Identity -> Router
edge Topic -> Swarm
edge Space -> Automerge, Feeds, State, Indexer bus
edge Agent -> Process
